fullPassage: In today's information age, in many companies and on many teams, the weights of individual capabilities and contributions have shifted. The knowledge used to do many jobs is now less private, harder to keep secret. Whereas in the past, authority derived naturally from mastery of information, today many people have access to the same sources. If knowledge is still power, it is a kind of power that is more widely shared. Consistent and repeatable processes and outputs are important, but they are not sufficient to stay competitive. Consistency and repeatability are more likely to suppress fresh thinking than to encourage it. In this knowledge economy, people who are merely managers — people who are primarily monitors of others' work — are of less value to a company than those who think of new ways to do things.

questions.passage: In today's information age, in many companies and on many teams, the weights of individual capabilities and contributions have (A)[shifted / fixed]. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) shifted=변화했다 / fixed=고정된 (B) secret=비밀의 / public=공개된 (C) widely=널리 / rarely=드물게
det.analysis:
✅ ② shifted — secret — widely: 정보화 시대에 역량의 비중이 '변화했고'(shifted), 지식은 '비밀로'(secret) 지키기 어려우며, 그 힘은 더 '널리'(widely) 공유된다 ←정답
❌ ① fixed: '고정된'은 비중이 변했다는 흐름과 반대
❌ ③ public: '공개로 지키기 어렵다'는 어색, 비밀로 지키기 어렵다가 맞음
❌ ④ rarely: '드물게 공유된다'는 널리 공유된다는 흐름과 모순
det.tip: shifted(변화)↔fixed(고정), secret(비밀)↔public(공개), widely(널리)↔rarely(드물게)

questions.passage:
(A) If knowledge is still <u>power</u>, it is a kind of power that is more widely shared.

(B) The storm knocked out the electricity, and the whole town lost <u>power</u> for several hours.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 power의 (A)와 (B)에서의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: power: (A) 힘·영향력 (B) 전력·전기
det.analysis:
✅ ③ (A) 지식이 여전히 '힘, 영향력'(power)이라면, (B) 폭풍으로 마을이 몇 시간 '전력, 전기'(power)를 잃었다 ←정답
❌ ① (A)와 (B)의 뜻이 뒤바뀜
❌ ② (A) '권한'은 지식의 힘이라는 맥락과 어울리지 않음
❌ ④ (B) '권력'은 전기가 나갔다는 문맥과 안 맞음
det.tip: power 다의어: ① knowledge is power(힘·영향력) ② lost power(전력·전기)

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "as much as is needed for a particular purpose"

det.korean: private=사적인 / competitive=경쟁력 있는 / repeatable=반복 가능한 / sufficient=충분한
det.analysis:
✅ ④ sufficient: '어떤 목적에 필요한 만큼 충분한'이라는 정의에 딱 맞아요 ←정답. 본문 'not sufficient to stay competitive' 참고
❌ ① private: '사적인'은 정의와 무관
❌ ② competitive: '경쟁력 있는'은 뜻이 다름
❌ ③ repeatable: '반복 가능한'은 정의와 무관
det.tip: as much as is needed(필요한 만큼) = sufficient(충분한)

questions.passage: If knowledge is still power, it is a kind of power that is more __________ (wide) shared.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (1단어) (영어로) 쓰시오.

det.korean: wide(넓은) → widely(널리): 뒤의 동사 shared(공유되는)를 꾸미므로 형용사가 아니라 부사가 필요하다.
det.analysis: 빈칸은 뒤의 shared(공유되는)를 꾸미는 자리예요. 동사·형용사를 꾸미는 말은 '부사'인데, 형용사 wide에 -ly를 붙이면 부사 widely(널리)가 돼요. 그래서 wide를 widely로 바꿔요.
det.tip: 동사(shared)를 꾸미는 부사: wide + ly → widely

questions.passage: Consistent and repeatable processes and outputs are important, but they are not sufficient to stay __________ (compete).
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (1단어) (영어로) 쓰시오.

det.korean: compete(경쟁하다) → competitive(경쟁력 있는): 'stay + 형용사(~한 상태를 유지하다)' 구조이므로 동사가 아니라 형용사가 필요하다.
det.analysis: 빈칸 앞 stay는 'stay + 형용사'로 '~한 상태를 유지하다'라는 뜻이에요. 그래서 동사 compete가 아니라 형용사 competitive(경쟁력 있는)로 바꿔야 'stay competitive(경쟁력을 유지하다)'가 돼요.
det.tip: stay + 형용사: compete → competitive

questions.passage: In today's information age, in many companies and on many teams, the weights of individual capabilities and contributions have shifted. The knowledge used to do many jobs is now less private, harder to keep secret. Whereas in the past, authority derived naturally from __________, today many people have access to the same sources. If knowledge is still power, it is a kind of power that is more widely shared. Consistent and repeatable processes and outputs are important, but they are not sufficient to stay competitive. Consistency and repeatability are more likely to suppress fresh thinking than to encourage it. In this knowledge economy, people who are merely managers — people who are primarily monitors of others' work — are of less value to a company than those who think of new ways to do things.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: fear of failure=실패의 두려움 / lack of data=자료의 부족 / mastery of information=정보의 숙달 / love of power=권력에 대한 사랑
det.analysis:
✅ ③ mastery of information: 빈칸 문장은 '과거에 권위가 ____에서 자연스럽게 나왔다'는 뜻이에요. 뒤에 '오늘날엔 많은 사람이 같은 정보원에 접근한다'가 대조로 이어지므로, 과거의 권위는 '정보를 잘 다루는 능력(정보의 숙달)'에서 나왔다는 것이 맞아요 ←정답
❌ ① fear of failure: '실패의 두려움'은 권위의 근원과 무관
❌ ② lack of data: '자료 부족'은 문맥과 반대
❌ ④ love of power: '권력에 대한 사랑'은 근거 없음
det.tip: authority derived from ___ → 정보의 숙달(mastery of information)

questions.passage: In today's information age, in many companies and on many teams, the weights of individual capabilities and contributions have shifted. The knowledge used to do many jobs is now less private, harder to keep secret. Whereas in the past, authority derived naturally from mastery of information, today many people have access to the same sources. If knowledge is still power, it is a kind of power that is more widely shared. Consistent and repeatable processes and outputs are important, but they are not sufficient to stay competitive. Consistency and repeatability are more likely to suppress __________ than to encourage it. In this knowledge economy, people who are merely managers — people who are primarily monitors of others' work — are of less value to a company than those who think of new ways to do things.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: strict rules=엄격한 규칙 / daily routines=일상 습관 / old habits=낡은 버릇 / fresh thinking=새로운 사고
det.analysis:
✅ ④ fresh thinking: 빈칸은 '일관성과 반복성은 ____을 억누르기 쉽다'는 자리예요. 뒤에 'than to encourage it(그것을 북돋우기보다)'로 이어지고, 이 글은 새로운 방식을 고안하는 사람을 높이 평가하므로, 억눌리는 대상은 '새로운 사고'가 맞아요 ←정답
❌ ① strict rules: '엄격한 규칙'은 억눌리는 대상으로 어색
❌ ② daily routines: '일상 습관'은 문맥과 무관
❌ ③ old habits: '낡은 버릇'을 억누르는 것은 오히려 긍정적이라 흐름과 안 맞음
det.tip: suppress ___ than to encourage it → 새로운 사고(fresh thinking)
